SELECT c.idColaborador, c.nombre, c.apellidoPaterno, c.apellidoMaterno, c.curp, c.correo, c.numeroPersonal, c.password, c.numeroLicencia, c.idRol, c.idSucursal,
r.nombre AS rol, s.nombre AS nombreSucursal
FROM colaborador c INNER JOIN rol r ON c.idRol = r.idRol LEFT JOIN sucursal s ON c.idSucursal = s.idSucursal
WHERE c.numeroPersonal = #{numeroPersonal} AND c.password = #{password}
